==About==

Crafting a {{i|'Shroom-Stuffed Bellpepper}} will make an {{i|Unbaked 'Shroom-Stuffed Bellpepper}} which can then be baked in a {{i|Bread Oven}} to produce a 'Shroom-Stuffed Bellpepper. When baking Foods in a Bread Oven there is a chance for them to become {{i|Animal Crackers}} instead. '''NOTE:''' Remember to boil your Mushrooms to reduce {{i|'Shroom Poisoning}}.
